summary: The change removes identifier-based login and registration oracles, keeps passkey login discoverable and adds regression coverage for unknown, password-only and passkey accounts. No actionable defects were found in the changed code or tests.

evidence: src/passport.ts handleLoginStart now returns a 200 publicKey response without allowCredentials or a challenge-bound userId for every identifier, eliminating not_found and no_credentials distinctions.

src/passport.ts password login and continue resolve every unknown or passkey-only identifier through the fixed dummy PasswordHash and return the same invalid_credentials body and status as a wrong password.

src/passport.ts password register requires a hub session before any create or login path and anonymous register start and finish deny claimed and unclaimed emails with the same registration_unavailable response after attestation verification.
src/handler_test.ts, tests/bun_test.ts and tests/worker_runtime.mjs add regression coverage for unknown, password-only and passkey accounts across login start, password continuation and registration.
